name: auto-read-otp
description: Build OTP verification screens in Jetpack Compose with auto-read-otp: a per-digit code input, SMS code reading through the SMS User Consent API and a resend countdown timer, plus migration from 1.x.

interface.shortDescription: OTP verification screens in Jetpack Compose
interface.longDescription: Add the auto-read-otp libraries to an Android app, build a verification screen with a per-digit code field, read the code from SMS through Google's SMS User Consent API without SMS permissions, show a resend countdown, and migrate code written for 1.x or 2.0.
defaultPrompt: Add a 6 digit verification code screen that reads the code from SMS
Add a resend button with a countdown to my OTP screen
Migrate this project to the latest auto-read-otp
